summary: The machine against you: Your signs come down overnight, and {staffer} says people who work for {the place} are being told not to help you.
realLife: Challenging Newark's longtime mayor Sharpe James in 2002, he was called a carpetbagger and too suburban to understand the city, and a documentary showed police and firefighters tearing down a big Booker sign. He lost about 53 to 47 and won in 2006.
gates: Workers or police on record pulling signs or pressuring staff (acts by people in the world, never authored).
weights: How many public workers live in your district.
choices: put the signs back up every night
film it and go to the press
answer the not-one-of-us charge at the doors

branches.then: The run-again question comes the morning after.

branches.then: What they catch becomes a record later scenes read.
